summary: Five Star Bancorp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 2,725,000 shares of common stock (plus a 30-day underwriter option for 408,750 additional shares) at a public offering price of $44.00 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately $119.9 million. The shares are listed on Nasdaq under FSBC with a recent closing price of $49.33. Underwriters are Keefe, Bruyette & Woods (bookrunner) and co-managers. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; the filing is an ordinary shelf takedown with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven component.
